{{Quote|We don't really want to see the Jedi rise from their graves, do we? The first band was troublesome enough. I won't have our descendants bowing to his, ruled by an oligarchy of spoon benders and readers of auras.|[[Ta'a Chume]]|<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
'''Spoonbender''' (sometimes spelled as '''spoon bender''') was a derogatory term used to describe a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The expression referred to the ability of a Jedi to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] bend an eating utensil. Such casual use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was frowned upon by the Jedi.<ref name="LFCFC">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Contention}}</ref>

Many years after the Clone Wars, [[Ta'a Chume]], [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], would still refer to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals as "spoon benders" and "readers of aura". Like many [[Hapan]]s, she nurtured a strong [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]], whence the use of derogatory terms.<ref name="copl" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "spoonbender" mirrors the real-life claim of certain "psychics", who report being able to [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spoon_bending bend objects without physical force].
